body:
@louy, that one's handled [correctly](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/blob/e6065235a682c5beae4a3f6e05cd7fa1b2813a3e/tests/lib/rules/no-unsafe-finally.js#L25).

Easiest way to test it yourself is to clone master, `npm install`, then `./bin/eslint.js --no-eslintrc --rule 'no-unsafe-finally: 1' test.js`.
It's obviously a bug, I presume it will be accepted. So I'm now working on a patch to fix it asap.
